status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Smith (thumb) was a limited participant in Monday's estimated practice, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: Smith was cleared to return to practice Monday after spending the first four weeks of the 2026 regular season on injured reserve. The offensive guard was limited in his first session back, and the Cowboys have a 21-day window within which to activate him or place him on injured reserve for the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Bullard (calf) on injured reserve Wednesday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
status.longComment: Bullard suffered a calf injury during the Cowboys' Week 3 loss to the Ravens. The injury is severe enough for him to require a stint on IR, which means he'll have to miss at least the next four games and is eligible to return for Week 8 against the Cardinals on Sunday, Nov. 1. Rookie fourth-rounder LT Overton could see a bump in rotational defensive snaps for as long as Bullard is on the shelf.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Thompson (hamstring) on injured reserve Wednesday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
status.longComment: Thompson sustained the injury in Sunday's loss to the Ravens and will now miss at least the next four contests. Markquese Bell filled in alongside rookie Caleb Downs at safety following Thompson's departure.
